full_judgment: 2. Facts, for disposal of the appeal in short are that the predecessor-in-interest of respondent os.1 to 7 namely Abul Hashem @ Hachen as pre-emptors instituted Miscellaneous Case being No. 22 of 1993 under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tehancy Act stating, inter alia, that he was co-sharer by inheritance of the land appertaining to S.A. Khatian No.249 of Mouja Khajura. His mother Chutu Bibi was also co-sharer of the said khatian who died leaving two sons, ie. the pre-emptor and pre-emptee No. 3. One Krishna Chandra was also co-sharer of the said khatian. On 08M641999 Zohur Ali told the pre-emptor that Krishna Chandra had sold the disputed land to the pre-emptee by kabla deed dated 1101.1985 who was a stranger in the case holding. The pre-emptor confirmed about the said deed on 08.06.1993. Hence, was the case.
